verdict.rationale: Pipedream's CLI offers `pd dev`, which links a local source file to a deployed component and auto-updates it on save, plus `pd deploy` from local code and UI test events. That gives a local-edit, cloud-run development loop, but only for event sources, not for running whole workflows locally or against a separate dev instance. Missing for 10: local execution of workflows, a dedicated dev/staging instance or environment, CI testing integration, workflow-level (not just source-level) local development, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing

citations.quote: pd dev` allows you to interactively develop a source from a local file.`pd dev` will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes.
When you save changes to your local file, your component will automatically be updated on Pipedream.
Deploy an event source from local or remote code.
Then you can select a specific test event and manually trigger your workflow with that event data by clicking Send Test Event.
